cases.question: How does URLSafeSerializerMixin.dump_payload decide whether to compress a serialized payload, and how does it indicate compression in the returned bytes?
cases.expected_answer: Serializes via super; zlib-compresses but uses compressed data only when len(compressed)<len(json)-1. Base64-encodes chosen bytes; prefixes b dot only if compressed.

cases.question: In TimestampSigner.unsign, which age checks can expire a correctly signed value when max_age is supplied, and what changes when return_timestamp is true?
cases.expected_answer: After signature and timestamp validity checks, computes age = get_timestamp()-ts_int; raises SignatureExpired when age>max_age or age<0. Boundary equal max_age is allowed. With return_timestamp returns value and converted timestamp; otherwise value alone.

cases.question: How do the core _safeParse and _safeParseAsync implementations handle a Promise returned by schema validation and choose the success or failure result?
cases.expected_answer: Sync ctx.async=false and throws ZodAsyncError for Promise. Async ctx.async=true and awaits Promise. Both use issues.length to call failure or return success:true,data:value.

expected_sources.name: _safeParseAsync
expected_sources.anchor_text: if (result instanceof Promise) result = await result

cases.question: In the core safe-parse failure helper, when is the error constructed, is it reused, and how are captured issues and context released when an error is read or replaced?
cases.expected_answer: failure returns success:false and getter/setter error. Getter creates Err from finalized issues only if cached error falsy, clears issues/context then returns cached error. Setter stores supplied error and clears captures. Later read reuses truthy cached error.
